system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: 任务 prompt 以 markdown 文件形式随代码分发，并通过 `runtime.prompt_group` 选择目录
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are markdown files with placeholders ({origin},{goal},{graph_yaml}) rendered per task

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Agent Workers run an OODA loop — Observe the full graph, Orient to the current state, Decide on next intents, Act to explore — and write their findings back as new Facts.
env_context_strategy.note: Workers also receive the full fact-intent graph in the prompt, so this could arguably be mixed. The README says 'zero RAG'. Worker tooling comes from the backend (Claude Code/Codex/Pi).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Agent Workers only receive a prompt and return structured output
context_compaction.note: Each task is a fresh prompt; no history compaction described

observation_format.evidence_quote: Dispatcher 固定从 `stdout` 取全文作为模型正文输出
observation_format.note: Worker returns text/JSON on stdout; tool observations inside the CLI are plain text

tool_call_format.note: Cairn parses JSON returned by the worker CLI; internal CLI tool-call format is external to Cairn

tool_count.note: Cairn defines no model-facing tools; worker CLIs (Claude Code/Codex) carry their own toolsets

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Agent Workers only receive a prompt and return structured output
edit_primitive.note: Cairn ships no edit tool; editing occurs inside the opaque worker CLI

tool_schema_source.note: Cairn exposes no model tool schemas of its own

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Zero MCP tools, zero RAG, zero predefined agent roles.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a **directed search through a near-infinite state space**
loop_primitives.note: State-space search over fact-intent graph; workers run OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The engine is built on a **Blackboard Architecture** with an explicit fact-intent graph.
planning_granularity.note: Intents are declared directions stored in the graph and re-read across steps

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Cairn Dispatcher reads the graph, schedules tasks, spins up and tears down worker containers
multi_agent_topology.note: Dispatcher schedules/spawns concurrent workers that coordinate via shared board (stigmergy)

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each project gets its own Worker Container; multiple Agent Workers run concurrently inside it.
delegation_mechanism.note: Dispatcher spawns worker processes/containers; they also communicate via the shared blackboard

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Hint | Human judgment injected at any time; absorbed by agents on the next read
human_in_loop.note: Humans can inject Hints but there is no gating/approval of actions, plans, or completion

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The engine is built on a **Blackboard Architecture** with an explicit fact-intent graph.
short_term_state.note: Facts/Intents/Hints graph is the structured working state

long_term_memory.note: Skill file shipped in the worker container

state_persistence.evidence_quote: 若项目在 `completed` 后被服务端 `reopen`，对 Dispatcher 来说也等价于“重新变成 active 且图上多了一个新 fact”；下一轮会按普通 active 项目继续调度
state_persistence.note: Server persists graph (./datas/cairn/); projects can be stopped, reopened and continued

self_verification.evidence_quote: `reason` 负责读图判断是否完成或是否需要提出一个新 intent
self_verification.note: reason task uses the same model class to judge goal completion; no harness test execution

retry_policy.evidence_quote: 两阶段都失败则 release 保留 intent，下轮仍按新项目重试
retry_policy.note: Failed intents are released and re-explored; search continues until goal (complete) is reached

rollback.evidence_quote:
整次探索作废
- 不写任何图数据
rollback.note: Failures discard the task rather than rolling back files; no git/snapshot revert described

termination_condition.evidence_quote: 主阶段成功时固定返回 `fact + complete`
termination_condition.note: Worker-declared `complete` ends the project; per-task timeouts also apply

cost_controls.evidence_quote: `runtime.max_workers`：Dispatcher 同时运行中的任务总数上限
cost_controls.note: Concurrency caps exist but no token budget, caching, or cost-based routing

timeouts.evidence_quote: 超时策略按任务类型定义
timeouts.note: Per-task timeout and conclude_timeout per worker invocation; no run-level wall-clock cap

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Each project gets its own Worker Container; multiple Agent Workers run concurrently inside it.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
这个容器是该项目的执行环境，通常负责：

- 提供工具链
- 提供网络环境
filesystem_access.note: Within the container the worker has full access; run with skip-permissions

network_policy.note: Container provides network for pentesting; no egress restriction described

permission_model.note: Workers run with skip-permissions / bypass-approvals; all model actions execute

tracing.evidence_quote: 运行日志按“状态变化优先”设计
tracing.note: logging.py present; graph state is persisted but per-step tracing is log-oriented

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The system had never been tested before the competition.
eval_hooks.note: No evaluation runner in the pinned repo; competition scoring external

guardrails.note: No input/output/action filters; permissions explicitly bypassed

target_domain.evidence_quote: A AI general-purpose state-space search engine, validated first on autonomous penetration testing.
target_domain.note: Penetration testing / security; positioned as general problem solver

open_source.evidence_quote: This project is licensed under **GNU AGPLv3** for personal and educational use.

model_agnostic.note: Configurable base URLs and multiple backends

first_release_date.note: Date of pinned tag v0.2.1; earlier release dates not in evidence
